target: acceptance 3 — a real suite combined with a case id that is not in it
cmd:
mkdir -p c
mkdir -p c/alpha
cat > c/alpha/a-1.json <<'CASEEOF'
{"id": "a-1", "target": "synthetic", "kind": "bash-unit", "cmd": "echo '{}'", "checks": [{"type": "exit_code", "equals": 0}]}
CASEEOF
mkdir -p c/beta
cat > c/beta/b-1.json <<'CASEEOF'
{"id": "b-1", "target": "synthetic", "kind": "bash-unit", "cmd": "echo '{}'", "checks": [{"type": "exit_code", "equals": 0}]}
CASEEOF
EVAL_CASES_DIR="$PWD/c" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/evals/run_eval.sh" --suite alpha --case b-1 >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{"code":%s}' $?
